name: YuE2
use_label: Songs from lyrics and a style prompt
one_liner: Generates music, makes zero-shot covers and edits parts of a track.

text.why: Music generators are hard to correct once a track exists; changing one part usually means generating the whole thing again. YuE2 plans the structure symbolically before generating and keeps zero-shot covers and agentic editing inside the same flow. It is written in Python, published under Apache-2.0, and has a demo page. You run the model yourself, so the environment is yours to prepare.
text.take: Planning a song as an editable score, then regenerating from the edit, sets it apart from one-shot generators.
build: A production line that makes your own background music for video
An experiment that re-sings an existing track in another voice

who.situation: works with symbolic planning and audio generation
runs a music model on a GPU server

caveat: Needs Linux, Python 3.12 and an NVIDIA GPU with 24 GB of VRAM
Code is Apache-2.0, but the model weights are CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial)
Model files download from Hugging Face on first use

license.scope_text: Commercial use, redistribution OK. Keep notices; mark changes.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.
